subject: Clarification about the reading paragraph
text:
The note I sent on Monday may have been unclear, and I would rather confirm than assume. When I mentioned a short paragraph on the reading guide, I did not mean a replacement for your syllabus or any change to your course materials. It was only for the small reference sheet used by the evening class before Friday.

I realize this week is unusually short, so I have not asked for anything beyond what was already in the earlier message. If the original request looked as though I wanted a full written response, that is my mistake, and I apologize for adding to your workload. It is only the one paragraph, and the deadline for the printed copies is tomorrow morning.

If that remains impossible, please say so, and I will ask the office to use the old guide. I do not want to repeat the request in a way that feels abrupt, particularly with your committee meeting still pending. If a few words would help, I can draft them and send for correction. I would not want this to disturb your schedule at the last moment. A brief reply by end of afternoon would be enough, and it would let me close the matter quietly.
